$0{,}33$, que es lo que pide el enunciad: $0.33$, which is what the question asks for
$0{,}333333$, con muchos decimales para: $0.333333$, with many decimals so as not to lose precision
$1/3$, y redondeo solo al final: $1/3$, and I round only at the end
<strong>Comprueba con las unidades.</str: Check with the units. If the result has to be a speed and a time comes out, there is an error and it shows without going over the arithmetic. Dimensional analysis is the cheapest check there is.
<strong>Los porcentajes encadenados se m: Chained percentages multiply, they do not add. Going up 10 % and down 10 % leaves you at 99 %, not at 100 %. Write each change as a factor and multiply them: it is shorter and it does not fail.
<strong>Redondea al final.</strong> Arra: Round at the end. Carrying the decimals along and rounding only when you write the answer avoids accumulated error, which in a multi-step problem changes the last figure and with it the mark.
<strong>Simplifica antes de operar, no d: Simplify before operating, not after. In fractions and in powers, cancelling first leaves small numbers and removes nearly every arithmetic slip. An answer left unsimplified usually scores less than a simplified one.
Cada tramo aporta un número fijo de preg: Each section contributes a fixed number of questions, drawn at random from its topics without repeating a topic while that is possible, and avoiding the most basic exercises. With 10 topics and 8 questions, a single exam does not touch them all: that is why the link at the end reproduces the same exam, and “another exam” draws a different one.
Cómo sacarle partido: How to get the most out of it
Descomponer un número en su valor posici: Breaking a number down into its place value; solving a combined operation respecting the order of operations and the brackets; factorising into primes and taking the greatest common divisor and the lowest common multiple.
Diez temas que son el suelo de todo lo d: Ten topics that are the floor everything else stands on: counting, operating, and knowing what a number is. This topic teaches nothing new: it asks. A procedural exam with exercises from the whole block, with a clock and no hints, because a gap here is paid for in [[al-lenguaje|algebra]] and goes on being paid for right up to the last integral.
El enlace de un examen corregido reprodu: The link to a marked exam reproduces the same questions with the same numbers. A teacher can do one, copy the link and pass it to the class: everyone will sit the same exam and will be able to compare results and procedures.
Elige los tramos que entran. Las pregunt: Choose the sections to include. The questions are drawn at random from the exercises of each topic in the block, avoiding the most basic ones and without repeating a topic while possible. There are no hints: the marking and the step-by-step solution come on submitting.
Lo que pide el enunciado es el <em>resul: What the question asks for is the result to two decimal places, not every step. With $0.33$ carried along, the end can come out wrong in the second figure.
Los exámenes de aritmética más antiguos: The oldest arithmetic exams that survive are Babylonian clay tablets from almost four thousand years ago: a question, room for the working and the expected result at the foot, so that the apprentice scribe could check himself. The structure is that of this exam, and so is the reason: arithmetic is learnt by doing it many times with different numbers.
Mejor que redondear pronto, pero sigue s: Better than rounding early, but it is still approximate and it takes longer to write. The exact fraction has no drawback at all.
Redondear en medio mete un error que los: Rounding halfway introduces an error that the following steps multiply. The fraction is exact and takes up no more room: carry it to the end and round once, there.
Repartos directa e inversamente proporci: Shares in direct and inverse proportion; chained rises and discounts, and the percentage that undoes another; checking a formula by dimensional analysis; placing a number on the real line and saying which set it belongs to.
Sumar y simplificar fracciones; decidir: Adding and reducing fractions; deciding whether a decimal terminates or recurs by looking at the denominator; turning a recurring decimal into a fraction; rounding to the significant figures asked for; operating with signs and with negative exponents.
Un examen de bloque es un simulacro hech: A block exam is a mock paper taken at home: with a clock, no notes and no hints. The questions come from the exercises of the 10 topics of the block, spread across sections, and every time you start one the numbers are different and so are the topics: doing it several times covers the whole block. On submission everything is marked, the step-by-step solution of each question opens, and the mark comes out section by section, with links to what is worth revising. The “tailored to what you have done” option puts first what you have not solved yet: it is the way to check that no topic is left untouched.
